cc.text: Good evening. It is midnight… and the city is at 49 degrees.
The sun set five hours ago. Nobody told the heat.
The heat is not spreading. It is… walking.
It started at a party in Sector 17. Guests say it was dead… until 11:58.
Police have one blurry photo. The heat source is… one man.
Officers tried to follow him. Their sunglasses melted.
Reports say he is walking into… our studio.

lyrics.en: I think even the mirror is jealous
I'm the one who sets the mood
I walk into the room and the weather gets better
Just tell them: that's the brand, man
I'm the trademark of the vibe
You just scroll and leave a remark
I'm the headline, you're just a highlight
I'm the light the spotlight follows

straps.text: THE SUN LEFT. THE HEAT DIDN'T.
HEAT FRONT MOVING AT WALKING SPEED
CCTV: THE HEAT SOURCE IS ONE MAN
HE IS HEADING TO OUR STUDIO
